review_response.finding: Vector set incomplete: only supply_chain, yet EX-0012/IMP-0013 need a command-carrying origin.
review_response.action: fixed: added ground and rf_link (basis weak, quote 'injecting instructions to manipulate control functions'; text names no origin) next to supply_chain (basis quote).

review_response.finding: EX-0002 and EX-0008 are name matches that need malware TR48 does not keep.
review_response.action: fixed: both and the EX-0008 children dropped. ENISA's 'faults in geofencing' is read as a logic flaw in flight software (EX-0009.01); 'time synchronization executions' is read as a weakness in time synchronization (EX-0012.12, IMP-0014), not an implant trigger.

review_response.finding: Time synchronization is read only as an execution trigger, so IMP-0014, EX-0012.12 vanish from every threat.
review_response.action: fixed: EX-0012.12 (K-ACTION) and IMP-0014 (K-EFFECT) kept for the time-synchronization item. EX-0014.01 stays dropped (a forged time source is a spoof).

review_response.finding: PER-0001 K-ENABLE for EX-0004 is an invented step that lets TR46/TR42 drop to it.
review_response.action: fixed: PER-0001 is D-UNDESCRIBED; ENISA says compromise of boot memory, not persistence. Peers were told not to point D-OTHER at it.

review_response.finding: Entry techniques coded K-ENABLE although ENISA names the supply-chain route.
review_response.action: fixed: IA-0001, IA-0001.01, IA-0001.02 are K-ACTION (same code as the equivalent wording in the supply-chain threats); the command-injection entries stay K-ENABLE because the origin is only implied.

TR57 shares only EX-0012.11 (D-OTHER to TR57).

coverage_notes: EX-0009.03 versus TR49: SPARTA has no zero-day flag. The boundary used is ENISA's own: TR49 contrasts zero-day exploits with 'regular software exploits' and speaks of vulnerabilities 'unknown to the user'; TR48 speaks of weaknesses from poor configuration and logic or implementation errors, which exist and can be remedied. Known-defect exploitation (EX-0009.03, REC-0008.03) therefore sits only here.
IA-0002 rests on reading 'software defied assets' as software-defined assets; this is the least certain keep.
